title: Overview of NCBI's SARS-CoV-2 Submission Process and Required Metadata
author: Ruth Timme
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b35iqq4e

steps.title: Review PHA4GE Contextual Data Specification
steps.instruction: Read the PHA4GE contextual data specification via the GitHub repository (https://github.com/pha4ge/SARS-CoV-2-Contextual-Data-Specification/tree/version_3_dev) before populating submission templates to ensure correct controlled vocabularies and ontology terms are used.

steps.title: Populate BioSample Metadata Template
steps.instruction: Download and populate the custom BioSample metadata template (SARS-CoV-2.cl.1.0_PHA4GE-V3.1.xlsx) using the PHA4GE contextual metadata SOP and GitHub repository for guidance.

steps.title: Populate SRA Batch Metadata Table
steps.instruction: Download and populate the custom SRA metadata template (SRA_template_PHA4GE-V3.xlsx) following the PHA4GE contextual metadata SOP and GitHub repository.

substeps.instruction: Create separate submissions and metadata tables for sequences belonging to different BioProjects.
Enter fastq filenames into the spreadsheet (on Mac, copy directly from folder; on PC, use command-line operations).
Perform a QA/QC step to verify files are associated with the correct sample name (e.g., use the Excel LEFT function to strip appended text and verify exact match with sample name).

steps.title: Populate GenBank Templates
steps.instruction: Complete the two required GenBank templates following the provided guidance.

substeps.instruction: Populate the GenBank structured comment template (GenBank-structuredComment_PHA4GE-V3.xlsx) to describe mapping or assembly methods.
Populate the GenBank source modifier template (GenBank-source_modifiers_PHA4GE-V3.xlsx), ensuring direct linkage to the respective BioSample records.
